title: Public repos in the org (inventory baseline)
sql: SELECT name, visibility, default_branch FROM github.repos.repos WHERE org = 'stackql' AND visibility = 'public'

title: Repos missing a license
sql: SELECT name FROM github.repos.repos WHERE org = 'stackql' AND JSON_EXTRACT(license, '$.key') IS NULL

title: Org members (review 2FA posture out-of-band)
sql: SELECT login FROM github.orgs.members WHERE org = 'stackql'
